summary: 121 duzeltilmis Ofcom CSV uyesi diske acilmadan resmî ZIP icinden dogrudan taranir; tam satir, global uniqueness, sema, alan, yuzde, uye SHA256 ve CRC kapilari uygulanir.

gates.name: ZIP_SIGNATURE_AND_VALIDATED_SOURCE
gates.detail: PK imzasi zorunlu; mevcut ZIP secim katmani minimum boyut, CRC, ZIP SHA256 ve r2 sayisini fail-closed dogrular.

gates.name: ZERO_R1_EXACT_R2_COUNT
gates.detail: Herhangi bir all-premises r1 uyesi reddedilir; tam 121 benzersiz r2 basename gerekir.

gates.name: NO_CSV_EXTRACTION
gates.detail: CSV uyeleri zipfile.open ile dogrudan okunur; 121 CSV icin disk extraction klasoru uretilmez.

gates.name: ALL_ROWS_AND_GLOBAL_UNIQUENESS
gates.detail: Gercek calismada tam 1.741.096 satir taranir; blank ve tum dosyalar arasi duplicate postcode reddedilir.

gates.name: STRICT_SCHEMA_AND_PERCENTAGE
gates.detail: Postcode, spaced postcode, area ve alti coverage yuzdesi zorunlu; yuzdeler 0-100 olmalidir.

gates.name: POSTCODE_AREA_CONSISTENCY
gates.detail: ZIP uye basename alani, postcode area alani ve postcode harf prefiksi ayni olmalidir.

gates.name: MEMBER_SHA256_AND_CRC
gates.detail: Her CSV uyesi tek akista SHA256 ile hashlenir; tam stream okuma ZIP CRC dogrulamasini tetikler.

gates.name: TARGETED_DETAIL_RETENTION
gates.detail: Ayrintili coverage yalniz same-row parcel/HMLR kimligi dogrulanmis slot postcode ihtiyaclari icin tutulur.

gates.name: FOUR_STATE_PARTITION
gates.detail: Proxy, identity conflict, postcode-not-found ve no-verified-postcode sonuclari ayrik ve tamdir.

gates.name: NO_SCORE_NO_WRITE
gates.detail: Nearest postcode, parcel skoru, business yazimi, DB, migration ve deploy yoktur.
